rate_slabs.tenure_text: 36 months 1 day to less than 60 months

warnings: Replaces prior buggy file (28 slabs) that had dumped the domestic FD + savings amount-tier tables into the NRE file with no NRE filtering. Per the source page, NRE rates equal the General Citizen column of the combined Domestic/NRO/NRE/Flexi FD table, restricted to tenures >= 1 year (page states 'Minimum tenor for NRE Deposit is 1 Year').
NRE deposits are INR-denominated; no currency field. Senior Citizen Rates do not apply to NRIs, so rate_senior_pct/rate_super_senior_pct are null.
Rates are for deposits below INR 3 crore (the only retail tier published in the combined table).
